name: Francophonie

flag.description: A white field with a ring of five curved segments in the centre, coloured green, purple, red, blue and yellow clockwise from the top.
flag.symbolism: The five coloured arcs stand for the five continents where French-speaking countries are found.

hook: The Francophonie is one ring broken into five coloured arcs on white, a single circle where the Olympics link five.
trivia: The emblem began as the logo of the 1987 summit in Quebec City and was made permanent on a proposal from Niger.
The OIF's roots go back to the Agency for Cultural and Technical Co-operation, founded in Niamey in 1970.
